svg.title: How wvc works
svg.desc: How wvc works, with values from the receipts. wvc hash: each tensor's bytes get a SHA-256, and the sorted lines get a root. wvc diff: equal ids are skipped; of four layer-15 tensors only mlp.down_proj differs, 65,260 weights in 64 columns, rank 1. wvc commit and checkout: the edited revision reuses 486 tensors by id and stores 2 deltas of 513 KB; checkout reproduces the Hub file byte for byte.
